_comment: Nexus Server egg. Import in Admin > Nests > Import Egg. See docs/PTERODACTYL.md.
name: Nexus Server
author: admin@nexus.local
description: Nexus API + WebSocket gateway + SQLite + uploads (single Rust binary). Downloads and auto-updates itself from GitHub Releases. Data persists in /home/container/data.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Downloads the launcher (nexus-start.sh) from the GitHub release. The launcher
# itself downloads/updates the nexus-server binary on every start.
set -e
cd /mnt/server
REPO="${GITHUB_REPO:-zyypj/nexus}"
VERSION="${NEXUS_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
  URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/nexus-start.sh"
else
  URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/v${VERSION#v}/nexus-start.sh"
fi
echo "Downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL -o nexus-start.sh "$URL"
chmod +x nexus-start.sh
mkdir -p data/uploads
rm -f .nexus-version
echo "Installed. The server binary is downloaded on first start."

variables.name: GitHub repository
variables.description: owner/repo whose GitHub Releases provide the server binary.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: latest = always the newest release; or pin a version such as 0.2.0.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: 1 = check GitHub on every start and install new releases (checksum verified). 0 = never.

variables.name: Listen address
variables.description: Interface to bind inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0.

variables.name: Listen port
variables.description: Leave empty to use the primary allocation port (recommended).

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Address clients use to reach this server, e.g. https://chat.example.com or http://203.0.113.5:3000.

variables.name: Data directory
variables.description: Persistent directory for nexus.db and uploads/ (inside the server volume).

variables.name: JWT secret
variables.description: Leave empty to auto-generate one on first start (stored in data/.jwt_secret). At least 32 characters if set.

variables.name: LiveKit URL
variables.description: URL clients use for media, e.g. ws://203.0.113.5:7880 or wss://media.example.com. Empty disables calls.

variables.name: LiveKit API URL
variables.description: Optional internal URL the server uses for LiveKit's API (defaults to LiveKit URL with ws->http).

variables.name: LiveKit API secret
variables.description: Must match the LiveKit egg. At least 32 characters.

variables.name: Public registration
variables.description: true lets anyone sign up without an invite code.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: error, warn, info, debug or trace.

variables.name: Trust proxy
variables.description: true only behind a reverse proxy you control (uses X-Forwarded-For for rate limits).

variables.name: TLS certificate
variables.description: Optional PEM certificate path (e.g. /home/container/tls/fullchain.pem) to serve HTTPS directly.

variables.name: TLS key
variables.description: Optional PEM private key path for HTTPS.
